# Write-free e2e: help-text regression for all subcommands
# (bead go-foundry-cli-wet.2.1).

# Root help exposes the documented subcommands and no banned flags.
exec foundry --help
stdout 'init'
stdout 'validate'
stdout 'plan'
stdout 'generate'
stdout 'catalog'
stdout 'doctor'
stdout 'version'
stdout 'authoritative dry run'
stdout 'no separate dry run'
! stdout 'completion'
! stdout '--offline'
! stdout '--force'
! stdout '--dry-run'

exec foundry help
stdout 'init'
stdout 'validate'
stdout 'plan'
stdout 'generate'
stdout 'catalog'
stdout 'doctor'
stdout 'version'
! stdout 'completion'
! stdout '--offline'
! stdout '--force'
! stdout '--dry-run'

# init help requires explicit --out (no discovery) and no banned flags.
exec foundry init --help
stdout '--out'
stdout '--name'
stdout '--module'
! stdout '--offline'
! stdout '--force'
! stdout '--dry-run'
! stdout 'completion'

# validate help describes the pure pipeline and rejects banned flags.
exec foundry validate --help
stdout 'complete pure pipeline'
stdout '--spec'
stdout '--dest'
! stdout '--offline'
! stdout '--force'
! stdout '--dry-run'
! stdout 'completion'

# plan help advertises itself as the authoritative dry run.
exec foundry plan --help
stdout 'authoritative dry run'
stdout '--verify'
stdout '--spec'
! stdout '--offline'
! stdout '--force'
! stdout '--dry-run'
! stdout 'completion'

# generate help describes project writes and still has no banned flags.
exec foundry generate --help
stdout 'Generated Project'
stdout '--verify'
stdout '--spec'
! stdout '--offline'
! stdout '--force'
! stdout '--dry-run'
! stdout 'completion'

# doctor help is advisory toolchain guidance.
exec foundry doctor --help
stdout 'FOUNDRY_GO_BIN'
! stdout '--offline'
! stdout '--force'
! stdout '--dry-run'
! stdout 'completion'

# catalog help exposes list/show subcommands and no banned flags.
exec foundry catalog --help
stdout 'list'
stdout 'show'
! stdout '--offline'
! stdout '--force'
! stdout '--dry-run'
! stdout 'completion'

exec foundry catalog list --help
stdout 'catalog list prints every validated unit'
! stdout '--offline'
! stdout '--force'
! stdout '--dry-run'
! stdout 'completion'

exec foundry catalog show --help
stdout 'catalog show prints one unit'
! stdout '--offline'
! stdout '--force'
! stdout '--dry-run'
! stdout 'completion'

# version help is also clean.
exec foundry version --help
stdout 'semantic version'
! stdout '--offline'
! stdout '--force'
! stdout '--dry-run'
! stdout 'completion'
